about: The nine: the valley and the eight world squares round it, 3 x 3 (1728 x 1728 cells, 27 x 27 chunks; docs/design/world-squares.md, J-080). A world file, not a bake: "generated" says the seed, the size in world squares, the generator's version, the squares pinned to a map folder and the far landmarks it must hold ("musts", WorldPlan's must-haves), and every other chunk is solved from them (Chem.WorldPlan, Chem.ChunkGen). The map's cells start at the north-west corner of its squares, so the valley, pinned at square [0, 2] (the south-west), is chunks (0..8, 18..26) and its rows lie 1152 cells further south than in its own folder. GeneratedMap.Bake writes the rest of this folder (cells.txt, land.json, things.json and the rows); those files are never committed, and the map's hash is of its inputs (GeneratedMap.InputHash). Spawn and expects are the valley's spawn moved, and what the bake makes.
